title: Record the uniform P112 cover counts
body:
## Summary
- The 120 E8 lines split into 112 nonframe roots and 8 frame roots. There are 3780 orthogonal pairs, and every common core has 24 roots of rank 7.
- Each nonframe root has 3 five-site covers, 336 in total. Each frame root has 945 eight-site covers, 7560 in total. Every accepted cover has support ranks 7, 6 and 4.
- No new kappa. This count does not infer an invoice floor.
